title: Demonstration against gender-based violence held in Vienna

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated against gender-based violence and patriarchal abuse on the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women.
tea.want: Participants called to stop femicides and end violence against women.
tea.changed: Nov 25: Hundreds marched through the inner city of Vienna starting from 18:15.

summary: On Wednesday evening, November 25, 2026, hundreds of people participated in a demonstration in Vienna's city center to protest against gender-based violence, coinciding with the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women. Chanting slogans against patriarchal violence, demonstrators marched along a route from Mariahilfer Straße to Resselpark. Organisers had registered an expected turnout of around 300 to 500 participants. Police accompanied the march and temporarily blocked streets along the route using over a dozen vehicles to manage traffic impacts. The protest marked the beginning of the annual awareness campaign against violence targeting women and girls.
response: Police briefly closed streets along the demonstration route using more than a dozen vehicles. According tooe24.at, the ÖAMTC had warned of potential traffic congestion.

updates.text: Hundreds of protesters marched through central Vienna on Wednesday evening against gender-based violence.
